context: Tests checking for a project-specific evidence location before defaulting, and validating screenshots.

checklist.name: Looked for an existing convention first
checklist.description: The agent inspects earlier entries or project docs for an existing evidence location before choosing a path.

checklist.name: Used the entry's sibling assets directory
checklist.description: The screenshot is saved in a directory named after the entry (for example `2026-10-01-checkout-fix/assets/`) rather than a shared `.context/evidence/` folder.

checklist.name: Did not default to .context/evidence/ blindly
checklist.description: The agent does not save the file to `.context/evidence/` without first checking the project convention.

checklist.name: Used playwright-mcp page.screenshot
checklist.description: The capture uses `page.screenshot()` with a `path` option.

checklist.name: Filename is date-prefixed and descriptive
checklist.description: The filename follows `YYYY-MM-DD-<kebab-slug>.png`, with today's date (2026-10-01).

checklist.name: Slug describes the content
checklist.description: The slug describes what the image shows (for example the checkout page after the fix), not `screenshot1`.

checklist.name: Validated the image file
checklist.description: The agent runs `file` on the PNG (or an equivalent check) to confirm it is a valid image.

checklist.name: Confirmed the file was written
checklist.description: The agent lists the directory (for example `ls -lh`) to confirm the artifact exists.

checklist.name: Referenced the artifact with a summary table
checklist.description: The response has an evidence table with the artifact path and a one-line description.

checklist.name: Linked the artifact from the entry
checklist.description: The journal entry or the response references the saved path relative to the entry.
